confidence_notes: I used two web searches. One found the RBA rate for 18 Nov 2026: 0.6720 USD per AUD at 4pm. The other found aggregated prices for Pai from cost-of-living sites, including Numbeo, livingcost.org and nomad sites. Those sites put a domestic draft pint at about THB 80 ($2.0-2.4), a cappuccino at about THB 59 ($1.8-2.1) and a cheap meal at $2-3.13. Their figures for a mid-range dinner for two varied widely, from $9 to $24. I chose a middle value, leaning higher because Pai has many tourist-oriented restaurants. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated them from local beer prices and what is typical in Thai tourist towns, where imported wine is heavily taxed, so they are less certain. Accommodation figures are general estimates; I did not check any booking sites. Rates in Pai are seasonal, and July falls in the green (rainy) low season, so the estimates assume lower-than-peak rates. All prices are typical figures and do not account for further price changes by July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are based on Pai cost-of-living data checked against Chiang Mai, the nearest major city. Pai is a small backpacker and tourist town where food and drink prices are similar to or slightly below Chiang Mai's. Accommodation is cheaper than Chiang Mai, and three-star options are mainly boutique resorts.
